derivation: from a prolonged form of (to mix a liquid with a solid;
strongs_def: perhaps akin to G5453 (φύραμα) through the idea of swelling in bulk), mean to knead; a mass of dough
it_def:
1) qualsiasi sostanza mescolata con acqua e impastata
2) una massa, un grumo
   2a) di pasta
   2b) di argilla
